chapter: Forming the band in New York
title: Dropping the Collegians name for Erskine Hawkins and his band
summary: The school started another Collegians, so the band became Erskine Hawkins and his band in 1934-35.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Yeah. Well, you gave them a good start cause they were able to really get it together later on. And, you emerged as the leader of the group. That's sort of clear how that happened. But, how did the name actually change? When did it actually become the Erskine Hawkins Orchestra?
Oh, well, the school originated another 'Bama State Collegians. So, we had to give that name up on account it's a school name.

It was the school name. So, then I made it Erskine Hawkins and his band because it was 'Bama State Collegians featuring Erskine Hawkins before that. So, when the school originated another name, we had to drop it.
You had to drop it. And, that was after you were out on your own, the band was out on their own?
That was in '34. It was closer to '35. Yeah, before '35 anyhow.
Yeah. We used it for just so many months in New York.
